rootCauses: Legacy DXF bytes passed through unchecked UTF8 decoding; invalid continuation consumption corrupted both text and physical line structure.
CIF Unicode string values were never decoded, and MTEXT logical chunks need assembly before one decoding pass.
Preview extents included text insertion points, without glyph bounds; minimum font size tied to the expanded extent would make long text grow again.
fix: Read header version/codepage with bounded ASCII values; use strict supported decoders, modernUTF8 and declared legacy defaults.
Separate complete physical group pairs, normalize numeric group codes and end atEOF before interpreting Unicode values.
Defer MTEXT text chunks, join and decode once; block escaped newline/markup structure injection, unsupported Unicode controls and incomplete surrogate pairs.
Freeze display sizes from geometry before adding conservative fallback-font bounds, without replacing text or using textLength distortion.

limits: Node mocked file API, Chrome rendering of actual returned SVG and data-image decoding; not WeChat WXML or physical devices.
Conservative Unicode text bounds avoid clipping; no CAD font/rotation/anchor fidelity is implied.
Four MTEXT literal/format combinations remain uncertified. Native regular/slow/recover/explicit Unicode helper differ; raw comparisons are in original fixtures.
Text-only long labels fit the viewBox, but full-drawing fit can make long text small; no device zoom/readability claim.

audit: The initial generator cp936 alias emitted ANSI1252 while encoding GBK bytes; corrected to gbk and asserted native original labels before certifying the12files. Faulty originals retained in previous exploration audit.

CIF helper, normal/slow plaintext and recover imports are distinct references. The12extra source fixtures retain every actual result and the native slow-parser error instead of one invented universal oracle.
Modern UTF8 surrogate pairs are Unicode characters; unsupported controls/unpaired surrogates are explicit errors rather than literal control notation.
Four existing MTEXT literal/inline-code gaps remain in8views;44images/bounds pass does not mean all44content views pass.

Text bounds use conservative font-space estimates; actual Chrome boxes verified for these files. This is not native CAD text geometry, original font face, rotated text or all Unicode mark sequence certification.
limits: Binary DXF, unsupported high-byte codepages and MIF not newly supported.
MTEXT inline formatting, escaped literal markers and original line layout remain incomplete.
Text rotation/anchor/width-factor, OCS, layers, font metrics and device zoom readability remain unverified.
Node mocked file API and Chrome only. No WeChat WXML/iOS/Android result.
